rig: scratch engine 8161 + scratch shell 8207 (isolated cwd .tmp/w2_scratch, snapshot copy of the live world), headless Chromium 1280x800, page ?debug=1

mechanism_diagnosis.question: why does a press show no visible dent in the browser while the engine reports huge dents

a_verts_carries_dent.verdict: REFUTED as the defect — /verts DOES carry the dent
a_verts_carries_dent.measurement: scratch engine, POST /tick_touch {hit:[0,4.444,0.700] (vertex-snapped belly), force_n:20000} -> GET /verts: nearest hit vertex displaced 0.3979 m (theory delta = F/(4*pi*sigma) = 20000/(4*pi*4000) = 0.3979 m, exact). dimple_m state = 0.397887, P_upper 0 -> 842272 Pa
a_verts_carries_dent.delta_stream: ?delta=1 serves kernel framing (magic 0xD1), keyframes carry the dent fully; runs carry the changed verts

b_delta_stream_drops_it.verdict: REFUTED — keyframes carry everything; runs carry the dent verts
b_delta_stream_drops_it.measurement: page checksum (RG.verts, __h16pickProbe sum1) equals the same checksum of the shell's /api/verts bit-for-bit at rest, during a held press, and after release (diff 0.0000; one 0.0093 transient mid-decay)

c_upload_path.verdict: REFUTED — buffer uploaded every poll; H16 parity holds under press

actual_defect.statement: the dent arrives and is uploaded, but the engine's kernel radius (3 cm) is below the mesh's own local vertex spacing (~3.7 cm near the belly) — the law is sub-Nyquist on this surface: the dent renders as a hairline slit a few pixels wide

measurements.page_pre_fix: 103 changed px (canvas, delta>12/255), bbox 7x27 px, max channel delta 81 — a vertical hairline (crop_side.png)
measurements.engine_reference: the engine's OWN /frame of the same press at its default camera: 1 px changed, max delta 3/255 (engine_rest/engine_press.png, 2560x1369) — the engine's default-camera render is LESS visible than the page's
measurements.trailer_number: the 0.045->0.4513 m 'dent on camera' is dimple_m (a state number), not a default-camera pixel measurement
measurements.conclusion: no camera at product distance can show a 3 cm Gaussian on a ~2 cm-vertex mesh; the hook was invisible in BOTH renderers

fix.shape: client-side press kernel in the page's WebGL vertex shader (the mandate's preferred shape), in REPLACE mode
fix.law: same amplitude law as the engine: delta = F/(4*pi*sigma), sigma = 4000 N/m (engine sigma_n_); Gaussian falloff with the regularization radius riding the amplitude (rad = amp: cup depth = cup radius — a shape law so the dent reads as a dimple at every force); release decays exp(-t/tau), tau = 0.5 s (engine tau_relax_), cutoff 1e-4 m (engine's 0.1 mm deterministic rest)
fix.replace_mode: the shader displaces the PRE-PRESS rest surface (meshRest -> restVbo, frozen inside 3*rad while the kernel lives) by the law ONCE; adding a second kernel on top of the streamed engine dent doubles the center displacement (measured at 50 kN: 1 m + 1 m = 2 m — the cup floor pierced the body)
fix.patch_gate: the kernel weight is gated by smoothstep(0, 0.5, dot(vertex normal, press-point normal)): full weight within 60 deg of the press normal, zero past perpendicular — measured without it, an ungated 0.4 m kernel pulled the far side of the hip and the thighs inward (melted pelvis)
fix.engine_changes: NONE — zero engine edits, no window #8 dependency; the streamed buffer and the engine's own law are untouched (RG.verts stays a bit-exact mirror of /api/verts)

falsifier.stated_before: headless browser, 20 kN press at the belly held, same camera before/during/after; px/m = 800/(2*tan(22.5 deg)*25.3 m) = 38.2 px/m at the belly; default press delta 0.3979 m = 15.2 px projected depth. PASS = (1) changed-px bbox width >= 15 px (a dent at least as wide as its own projected depth; pre-fix was 7 px), (2) >= 1000 changed px (pre-fix 103), (3) blob shape: >= 10 rows with >= 5 changed px (not a line), (4) dent present by +0.7 s, monotone tau decay, gone (<= 20% peak) by +2.0 s
falsifier.verdict: PASS on every bar; the page now exceeds the engine's own default-camera presentation by >1000x

slider_fix.diagnosis: the page drew TWO slider-looking bars: the native track inside the input AND a separate #force-meter div (9-20 px below the real hit box at the shipped layout); buyer drags aimed at the impostor drawing (4/5 failed in the buyer session); the H7 D4 pointer-events patch only made the impostor pass clicks through
slider_fix.fix: the impostor div is removed; the input's own track draws fill + gentle threshold tick + thumb (::-webkit-slider-runnable-track / ::-moz-range-progress), so drawn == hit box by construction; the note's tick is aligned to the input's tick column in JS (and re-aligned when the play screen becomes visible)

verification.tick_alignment: warn tick pixel column 47 == 0.1515 * 197 px track target 47
